$comment: Example admin file for a first install. Copy it to config/gateway-admin.<name>.json, then change each models[].deployment to a Claude deployment name in your Microsoft Foundry account (az cognitiveservices account deployment list lists them). Gateway.Premium may use both models and Claude Desktop; Gateway.Standard uses Sonnet only. deployment.adminApi turns on the spend-limits API the admin console uses; deployment.database managed keeps spend and chargeback across configuration saves (ADR-0012). The budgets row caps the whole organization at 100 USD a month. Guide: docs/learn/tutorial-first-install.md.
